blocks.prompt: 10. The sum of 9 terms of an A.P. is 171 and its eighth term is 31. Find the series.
blocks.explanation:
"Find the series" ka matlab hai series ki terms likh kar dikhana. Iske liye sirf do cheezein chahiye: pehli term \(a_1\) aur common difference \(d\); baqi sab inhi se banti hain.
Diya kya hai? 9 terms ka jama 171 aur 8th term 31.
Find kya karna hai? \(a_1\) aur \(d\), aur phir series.
Plan: jama se ek equation, 8th term se doosri equation, dono ko mila kar solve.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S_9 = 171\), \(a_8 = 31\).
Humein find karna hai: series.
Tareeqa: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n - 1)d]\) se ek equation aur \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se doosri. Do unknowns, do equations: simultaneous equations ki tarah hal karenge.

Jama se equation
\[171 = \dfrac{9}{2}(2a_1 + 8d)\]
\[171 = 9(a_1 + 4d)\]
\[a_1 + 4d = 19 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: \(n = 9\) rakha to \((n - 1)d = 8d\). Bracket ke dono terms even hain, to \(\frac{1}{2}\) andar le ja kar \(a_1 + 4d\) bana. Phir dono taraf 9 se divide: \(171 \div 9 = 19\).
Khoobsurat baat: \(a_1 + 4d\) asal mein 5th term hai, yani 9 terms ki A.P. ki beech wali term 19 hai. Jama = terms ki tadaad × beech wali term.

8th term se equation
\[a_1 + 7d = 31 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: \(a_8 = a_1 + (8 - 1)d = a_1 + 7d\).

Solve karein
\[(2) - (1):\ 3d = 12\]
\[d = 4\]
\[a_1 = 19 - 4(4) = 3\]
Kyun: Minus karne se \(a_1\) cancel hua aur \(3d = 12\) bacha. Phir \(d = 4\) ko (1) mein rakha: \(a_1 = 19 - 16 = 3\).
Dhyan dein: \(7d - 4d = 3d\) hai; jaldi mein \(11d\) mat likhiye.

Series likhein
\[3 + 7 + 11 + 15 + \dots\]
Kyun: Pehli term 3 se shuru kar ke har dafa 4 jorte gaye.

Tasdeeq
\[a_8 = 3 + 7(4) = 31 \;\checkmark\]
\[S_9 = \dfrac{9}{2}(3 + 35)\]
\[= 9 \times 19 = 171 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 8th term 31 aayi aur 9th term \(3 + 8(4) = 35\) le kar jama 171 aaya. Dono di hui baatein poori ho gayin.
blocks.final_answer:
Series: \(3 + 7 + 11 + 15 + \dots\) (\(a_1 = 3,\ d = 4\))
Answer key bhi \(3 + 7 + 11 + \dots\) deti hai.
